name: Solution Design & Architecture semantic-family reconciliation
methodology: Preserve each of the eleven D1 concepts as a distinct architectural competency. Mechanical A/B variants are one semantic family each. Cross-domain lookalikes remain separate where the responsibility changes: architecture engineering is D1; stakeholder alignment/negotiation is D6.
crossDomainBoundary: Engineering latency/error budgets and fallback behavior is D1 SLA engineering; communicating constraints and negotiating an achievable SLA is D6. Architecture decision records are D1 when they preserve technical rationale; D6 covers stakeholder-facing handoff and implementation guidance.
contentMutationPolicy: Metadata/selection reconciliation only; no question text is changed in this PR.
